R1: One sentence, area honest at every level; the ₹10 dot is a near-invisible speck.
R2: Quarters make change countable and give the best accumulate animation; ₹10 still a sliver.
R3: Calmest cards (≤13 marks) and exactness on demand; level 0 hides the ₹100 tile above ₹1,000.
R4: "A cup of ₹100" reads instantly, remainder legible as a level, fill/drain is natural motion.
R5: Exact to ₹10, but the frame needs a 16px+ tile; at card size it is noise.
R6: Fewest marks and fun to build, but volume is misjudged ~3×; breaks "1 tile = ₹100" visually.
R7: Simplest, but ₹10, ₹25 vanish and ₹99 rounds up: chai spends disappear from the picture.
R8: Compact, but ×count is a number on Home and the icon no longer has area.
R9: Friendly icons, but a crate looks ~3× a box, not 10×. Isotype rule broken.
R10: Always fits, never honest: ₹1,23,000 looks ~3× ₹1,250. Kept as the warning case.
R11: Sensible per surface, but two rules to learn and the same ₹ looks different on two tabs.
R12: Instantly familiar, but six shapes and 246 notes for ₹1,23,000.
R13: R1 with play value; studs double the visual noise on blocks.
R14: Exact and compact, but a bead is worth 10× its neighbour: place value, not area.

QS: P2b-Q1
Which resolution system should v12 use?
A · Cup tiles (R4) + snapping motion (R2) + tap to zoom (R3)
B · Crumb dots (R1), greedy, no zoom
C · Zoom-first (R3): cards show bars and blocks only
D · Rounded (R7): whole tiles, exact on tap
A
One sentence ("a square is ₹100, it fills like a cup"), area-honest at every level, and both animations come for free.
P2b-Q2
How exact are amounts below ₹100?
A · Exact cup fill (₹10 = a thin floor line)
B · ₹25 quarters (₹10 rounds up to one quarter)
C · No crumbs; exact ₹ only on tap
A
Chai-sized spends are the habit Trickle exists for; they must stay visible.
P2b-Q3
What does tapping a tile visual do?
A · Zooms one level: block → tiles → ₹10s
B · Shows the exact ₹ in a tooltip
C · Nothing (opens detail screen)
A
Zoom keeps the tile language when you want detail; the ₹ figure sits in the zoomed view.
P2b-Q4
Should Savings and Income round to whole tiles while Spending stays exact (R11)?
A · No: one rule everywhere
B · Yes: savings/income round, spending exact
A
Two rules cost learnability; at ≥₹1,000 the cup remainder is already small next to the bars.
